patch_description: This redesign uses a portfolio-and-refill architecture. It builds a diverse beam of valid input-derived scaffolds, completes each with a balanced low-blocking greedy insertion policy, then applies bounded ruin-and-refill moves from several elite states. Deletion candidates are selected using explicit unique length-three-path obstruction credits, while refill temporarily bans removed edges so the search must first explore genuinely new replacements. Every retained candidate is explicitly verified C4-free, and the final output has a conservative repair-and-saturation safety phase.
